title: fix(social): retry Discord webhook 5xx responses
author: iotserver24
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Retry explicit Discord webhook 5xx responses up to three times.
- Do not replay network timeouts, where the message may already have been posted.
- Use the shared sender for realtime, weekly, and model-news posts.

Addresses #15023 (the observed 503; leave the workflow issue open until a successful run).
Fixes #15418.

The separate #15002 Reddit publishing failure is not addressed.

## Verification
- Local smoke checks: 503/500 retry, no 429 or timeout replay, multipart payload preserved.
- Python compile check.

gist.headline: The webhook gets three tries
gist.blurb: Discord 5xx hiccups now get up to three careful retries before the hive gives up. Timeouts stay untouched, because a message might already be happily buzzing in the channel.
gist.summary: Social publishing now retries explicit Discord webhook 5xx responses up to three times through a shared sender used by realtime, weekly, and model-news posts, while leaving 429s and network timeouts unreplayed.
gist.impact: Discord announcements should recover automatically from transient 500/503 responses without risking duplicate posts after an ambiguous timeout.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-post office where Polli carefully sends a message-envelope through a retro Discord-like webhook terminal three times after a small 503 error sign; the repeated attempts are represented by three gentle stepping stones, while a timeout cloud is deliberately left alone. Include code-plants and a reliable shared dispatch box to represent the common sender.
